Hotel.title: Hotel
Hotel.description: Public/QR-accessible hotel registration status record without PII.

id.description: Unique hotel identifier matching the Firestore document ID and ?hotel= QR parameter.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the hotel account owner.

status.description: Approval and operational status managed by the app owner.

isActive.description: Whether the hotel QR check-in page is currently active.

expiresAt.description: Subscription expiration timestamp, or null while pending initial approval.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the hotel registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the hotel status or profile was last updated.

termsText.description: Hotel-specific check-in terms and policies editable by the hotel owner.

welcomeTemplate.description: Default welcome message template editable by the hotel owner with dynamic placeholders.

HotelPrivate.title: Hotel Private Contact Info
HotelPrivate.description: Isolated PII subcollection storing the hotel's contact email and reception mobile number.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the hotel owner.

email.description: Contact email entered in the hotel registration form.

ownerEmail.description: Verified Google account email of the hotel owner.

receptionPhone.description: Reception WhatsApp/mobile number in digits-only international format.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when contact info was saved.

CheckinSession.title: Check-in Session
CheckinSession.description: Real-time guest self check-in session synchronized between the guest device and the hotel portal.

id.description: Unique unguessable UUID session identifier matching the Firestore document ID.

hotelName.description: Display name of the target hotel.

hotelOwnerUid.description: Owner UID of the target hotel for secure list queries.

guestName.description: Full name of the primary guest.

passportData.description: Structured ID/passport and booking fields extracted via Gemini and reviewed by the guest.

status.description: Current workflow state of the check-in session.

roomNumber.description: Assigned room number entered by the hotel upon approval, or null while pending.

welcomeMessage.description: Custom welcome message entered by the hotel upon approval, or null while pending.

roomPrice.description: Original room price entered by the hotel upon approval, or null while pending.

discountedPrice.description: Final room price after discount entered by the hotel upon approval, or null while pending.

discountPercent.description: Auto-calculated discount percentage (0-100) for hotel reference only, or null while pending.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the check-in session was created.

approvedAt.description: Server timestamp when the hotel approved the check-in, or null while pending.

cancelledAt.description: Server timestamp when the hotel reception cancelled the check-in, or null if not cancelled.

AdminUser.title: App Owner / Admin User
AdminUser.description: Authorized app owner account allowed to approve, suspend, renew, and delete hotels.

addedAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted.

/hotels/{hotelId}/private/{docId}.description: Isolated PII subcollection for hotel contact email and reception mobile number.

/checkin_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Collection of real-time guest self check-in sessions.
